'''''Laughing Dancer''''' was a [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] operating during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. A [[Starship/Legends|ship]] crewed by friends of the ''Laughing Dancer'' was captured by [[Buula's Raiders]] and taken to [[Buula Nen]]'s [[Buula's Rocky Home|Rocky Home]]. The crew of the ''Laughing Dancer'' sought to reacquire the freighter and its crew, and were advised by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Nomar]] to try and buy back their goods from Buula rather than risk a frontal assault.<ref name="HS" />
